messages:
nina: Heads-up: PMs set removal date for old v1 model aliases -> 2062230000. Need migration blurb + tiny SDK snippets for JS/Python and a grep replace example.

todd: I can do JS/Python snippets. Do we want default to error or auto-fallback? Runtime decision?

eli: Runtime default will return an explicit error `model_alias_removed`. Users can pass `auto_fallback=true` to opt into routing to a compatible v2 variant. We also emit header `x-rw-served-variant`.

todd: Cool. I'll show both flows (error + auto_fallback). Keep examples <=5 lines.

nina: Add a one-line cli: `rg "redwood-1" -n || true` and sed example, plus a short note to review changes before committing.

doc-bot: Docs workflow: label PR `docs:migration` and assign `@nina` for final review.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled 2062231000. Build will fail on missing `migration` front-matter.

todd: I'll open PR and ping for review. Short and sweet. :thumbsup:
